d.RaceName: AMENDED PLAN OF the City of Hardin GOVERNMENT
d.calcCandidate: FOR the existing form of government consisting of a general powers Commission-Executive with ward-based election of the City of Hardin City Council members and the at-large election of a Mayor.

d.RaceName: AMENDED PLAN OF the City of Hardin GOVERNMENT
d.calcCandidate: FOR adoption of a self-governing charter government in the form of a Commission-Executive with ward-based election of the City of Hardin City Council members and the at-large election of a Mayor, as proposed by the City of Hardin Study Commission.
